clk_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin used for the clock line of the SPI bus.

*See also: [SPI Bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi#configuration-variables)*

data_pins.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Must be a list of exactly 4 pins to be used for the quad SPI output data lines, or exactly 8 pins for octal mode. Not used for single mode.

*See also: [SPI Bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this SPI hub if you need multiple SPI hubs.

*See also: [SPI Bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi#configuration-variables)*

interface.docs:
Controls which hardware or software SPI implementation should be used.

*See also: [SPI Bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi#configuration-variables)*
